title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.6
subtitle: Reliable Bake startup and readable error messages.

highlights.title: Unbaked scenes can start
highlights.description: Empty simulation modifiers saved with a directory reference no longer trigger the previous-cache authentication error. Recorded playback caches remain protected.

highlights.title: Errors stay inside the window
highlights.description: Long error summaries, recommendations, and metadata wrap to the available panel width. The details window grows to fit the wrapped message.
